title: Closed form for simulation time
statement: For all natural numbers $k,t$, the recursively defined time function satisfies $\sigma_k(t)=2kt^2+(5k+4)t+(2k+2)$.
replaced:
The function $\sigma_k$ defined by $\sigma_k(0) = 2k+2$ and
$\sigma_k(t+1) = \sigma_k(t) + (4t+7)k + 4$ satisfies, for all $k, t \in \mathbb{N}$,
\[
\sigma_k(t) = 2k\,t^2 + (5k+4)\,t + (2k+2).
\]
